title: docs(README): the Kanban Board example now validates under safeValidateSchema (objectui#8256)
body:
Fixes #8256

## What was broken

The root README's "Kanban Board" example authored its lanes as
`{ value, label, color }`. The document is a `type: "object-kanban"` one, so
`objectql.zod.ts#ObjectKanbanSchema` judges it, and that face declares `columns`
as a UNION OF TWO ARRAYS — bare value strings, or `{ id, title }` lanes
(objectui#8913). A `{ value, label }` lane is neither arm, so the whole board was
refused. Measured through the shipped validator, before the fix:

```
PROBE_SUCCESS=false
PROBE_ISSUE invalid_union path=["columns"] :: Invalid input
```

A reader who copied the block got a rejection.

## ⚠️ Three of the card's own premises were re-measured and do NOT hold on today's tree

The card triaged on `0558e0f` (2026-09-07). objectui#8802 landed after it.

1. **The example is not a `type: "kanban"` document, and its line numbers moved.**
   The card cites `README.md:309-318` and `"type": "kanban"`. On `f0f4d6c` the
   example is at `README.md:249-263` and reads `"type": "object-kanban"`. The
   `kanban` arm is RETIRED (objectui#8802) and `KanbanSchema` is no longer
   exported at all, so the card's acceptance box — "validates against
   `KanbanSchema`" — names a symbol that does not exist. The board is judged by
   `ObjectKanbanSchema`; the card's other citation moved too
   (`KanbanColumnSchema` is at `complex.zod.ts:131-139`, its `color` tombstone at
   `:138`, not `:95-97` / `:101`).
2. **`color` on this lane is NOT a named refusal — it is ACCEPTED AND DROPPED.**
   `ObjectKanbanLaneSchema` is a plain strip-postured `z.object`, so a lane
   carrying `color` parses green and the key is silently stripped from the parsed
   document (measured; the parsed board comes back as
   `{"id":"todo","title":"To Do"}`). The named refusal the card cites lives on
   `complex.zod.ts#KanbanColumnSchema`, which judges nothing authored today.
   ⇒ validity alone cannot see this key, which is why the pin also asserts on the
   page TEXT.
3. **`cards` is NOT required here.** `ObjectKanbanLaneSchema.cards` is
   `.optional()`, and its docblock says why: `@objectstack/spec` describes a lane
   as `{ id, title }` per `groupBy` value, and requiring `cards` would make this
   repository narrower than the protocol.

The repair the card asked for is still the right one; two of its three reasons
were not. The lanes are now `{ id, title }` with the lane colour carried by the
declared `className` — the remedy the retired `color` key's own tombstone names,
and a key `KanbanImpl` really does compose into the column's `cn(...)` (an
authored lane is spread through `bucketCardsIntoColumns` intact).

`titleField` → `cardTitle` is kept from the card's scope but on a different
ground: both spellings parse, and the card's ground (the `kanban` arm's one
spelling) retired with the arm. The live ground is the protocol —
`@objectstack/spec@17.4.0`'s `ObjectKanbanPropsSchema` describes `titleField` as
the *"Legacy fallback for `cardTitle` (the board reads `cardTitle || titleField`).
Prefer `cardTitle`"* — and `plugin-kanban`'s own registration inputs say the same.

## ⚠️ The card's "no gate reads the root README's `json` fences" is false as written

Gates DO read them: `check:doc-types` reads every `type` literal in this
README's fences and `check:doc-fences` reads their language tag, both widened
onto the root page by objectui#7115. What no gate does is VALIDATE the fence —
`check:doc-types`'s own header names "whether the snippet's OTHER keys are read
by the renderer" as the question it deliberately does not answer, and
`check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples` compile `ts`/`tsx` fences, of which a
`json` block is not one. The card's conclusion (nothing was watching, so it
stayed green) holds; its premise does not. Both gates were re-run here and are
green on the repaired page.

## The pin, and why it moved packages

`packages/types/src/__tests__/readme-kanban-example-8256.test.ts` extracts the
fence on every run and parses it — never a retyped copy, which would drift from
the page it claims to pin. It carries its own control: the HISTORICAL lane shape
must still be refused, so the green is a measurement and not a validator that
accepts anything.

It first landed in `scripts/__tests__`, which the dispatch offered and which owes
no changeset. That is measurably wrong: `ci.yml` runs `pnpm type-check:scripts`
in the CHEAP half of the `type-check` job, BEFORE the `^build` that
`pnpm type-check` depends on, so `packages/types/dist` does not exist yet and the
import reds the step (`TS2307: Cannot find module '@object-ui/types/zod'`).
Under `packages/types/src/__tests__` the subject resolves relatively
(`../zod/index.zod`), which is also what `check:self-import` requires.

That puts the file under published source, so the gate is obeyed rather than the
card's `skip-changeset` note — an EMPTY-frontmatter changeset, the exemption
`check-changeset-presence` itself names:

```
✅  1 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)
    Every one of them has an EMPTY frontmatter — declared as releasing nothing
```

`scripts/markdown-test-inputs.mjs` gains the new reader, so a README-only pull
request runs the shard that reads it (its `--audit` refused the file until the
entry existed).

## Ablation — the pin can fail

Mutation and restore both proved on disk, from the committed state, with the
`git hash-object` of the path compared against its `HEAD` blob each way.

| leg | README `columns` | vitest |
|---|---|---|
| repaired (HEAD) | `{ id, title, className }` | `4 passed`, exit 0 |
| mutated | `{ value, label, color }` | `2 failed \| 2 passed`, exit 1, `+ "invalid_union [columns]: Invalid input"` |
| restored | blob `38bb5c28` == `HEAD:README.md` | `git diff HEAD` empty |

## Acceptance

- [x] the example validates against the shipped validator — discharged by the
      TEST arm, run on every CI shard, rather than a recorded run that rots the
      next time someone edits the README.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 根 README 的看板示例过不了 `safeValidateSchema`,泳道写成了
`{ value, label, color }`,而 `object-kanban` 这一面只认 `{ id, title }` 或纯字符串
两种数组。示例改成 `{ id, title, className }`,`titleField` 改为协议偏好的
`cardTitle`,并加一个从 README 现场抽取 fence 的 pin 测试。

**为什么改** —— 照抄首页示例的读者拿到的是一次校验拒绝。卡片开出时是对的,但它
三条依据里有两条在 objectui#8802 之后已经不成立(详见上文),按卡面照做会写出一个
运行时不判的键。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 只动文档与测试,无已发布行为变化(空 frontmatter
changeset)。pin 落在 `packages/types/src/__tests__`,因此该包欠一次 changeset;
这是门禁的判定,不是卡片的备注。回滚 = revert 这两个 commit,无迁移、无数据面。

**席位意见** —— (留空,待席位定稿)

**你要做的** —— 确认 `titleField` → `cardTitle` 这一改动符合你的意图:两种拼写都能
通过校验,`cardTitle` 是协议偏好且渲染器优先读的那个,但它在本仓 `ObjectKanbanSchema`
上并未声明,走的是 `BaseSchema` 的 passthrough(见报告里的 out-of-scope finding)。
